The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Commons identifies the lunette figure in the nave of Hosios Loukas Monastery, Boeotia, as Nikon Metanoeite. The epithet Μετανοεῖτε is borne by this saint only, and Hosios Loukas is in the Boeotian country where he preached. Commons describes it: Hosios Loukas Monastery, Boeotia, Greece
